title: ContainmentPolicy
description: An enforceable containment policy that bounds a destructive/offensive agent's capabilities. Named by a policy://containment/<name> ref from an admission manifest and resolved to governance/containment/<name>.json. tools/authorize.py DENIES a destructive/offensive action unless this policy file resolves AND its required_conditions are satisfied by the action context (deny-by-default). A containment ref that does not resolve to a real policy file is a fail-closed DENY.

policy_ref.description: Canonical ref, matching the admission manifest's containment ref and this file's name.

default_effect.description: Deny-by-default. The verb is denied outside the required_conditions.

required_conditions.description: Every present condition MUST be satisfied by the action context. A missing context value for a present condition is treated as unmet (fail-closed).
